title: The Delayed Field Chapter
story: Nadia brought her supervisor a chapter that lacked the March interviews. Professor Adeyemi refused to treat the missing voices as a small gap. Ethics approval had arrived late, and two participants had withdrawn after reading the consent form, leaving notes from only four of eight people. Nadia wanted to fill the space with published studies and keep the original date. Adeyemi said that substitution would change the chapter's claim, which had promised firsthand accounts of night-shift cleaners. A later deadline was possible if Nadia narrowed the group and stated the limit openly. They agreed the chapter would rest on the four completed interviews, plus a section explaining the absences. Nadia would send that section by Friday and the full chapter three weeks later. The extension was real, yet conditional on honesty about the reduced sample. A literature review could not disguise the absence of the people the project had set out to hear.
